name: attention_fullverify_warps8_b32_v1
hypothesis: Double producer partition from four to eight warps for full-context q_len=8 verify; retain four-stage shared-memory ring and all math, increase outstanding KV load parallelism on the latency-limited kernel.
decision_reason: Eight producer warps first failed Gluon layout validation. After matching the producer layout to eight warps, the candidate entered a sustained 100% GPU run with no output for over five minutes. The Modal app was stopped to cap cost; this is a synchronization-hang failure, with no timing or correctness result.
